meta.pain-targeted: "Cosa diresti adesso a te di tre anni fa?" - confronto temporale

image-generation.prompt-elaborate:
A 45-year-old Italian woman (use Elena Higgsfield reference) holding her smartphone in both hands, looking at the screen with a direct attentive expression - she is showing the screen to camera as if saying "look at this". On the screen we see what looks like a Photos app with a single photo thumbnail (intentionally blurred so we cannot identify the subject). She holds the phone slightly raised so both her face and the phone are visible.
She wears practical home clothes (simple top, comfortable). Clean modern home setting, neutral background (white wall or soft beige), soft natural daylight from upper-left, NEUTRAL white-balanced color (NOT warm golden Mediterranean grading). Her expression: coach direct, slight knowing smile, "I want to ask you something" energy.
CRITICAL STYLE: PRACTICAL coach moment, clean modern photography, NOT editorial cinematic. NOT vintage desk lamp scene. Real Italian woman 45, natural skin, no retouching. Phone screen content blurred (we see it's a photo but not WHO).
Composition: subject from chest up, phone in lower-third visible, plenty of clean negative space top/bottom for brand overlay.
image-generation.negative-prompt: cinematic editorial, Wim Wenders intimate, vintage desk, candle light, golden hour, polaroid prop, dramatic, sad, harsh light, makeup heavy, beauty filter, photo on screen clearly visible, fashion pose

design-brief.instructions: Layout brand WINNER v5 con foto Elena come background.
